settings.computerUseHint: Let the AI see the screen and drive mouse/keyboard to operate your apps (screenshot → act → verify). Each input action still asks for approval in chat.

settings.pluginDbSectionHint: Plugins that declare the 'database' permission get their own isolated DB user and schema. Authorization is required before each plugin can access its database.

settings.updateProxyUrlHint: Leave blank to use GitHub. For an intranet/offline deployment, enter the FY-Proxy base URL (e.g. http://10.0.0.5:8088). The intranet channel supports only the Infinia Windows portable ZIP and lite x64 deb package.
settings.guardHint: Rules are evaluated before the permission mode: hooks → deny → ask → allow → mode default. A deny always wins; dangerous commands (rm, sudo, git push…) are never auto-approved by allow rules.
settings.guardRuleSyntax: Syntax: Command(git status), Command(git:*), Tool(excel_*), Effect(read), Mcp(github__*), WebFetch(domain:example.com) — one rule per line.
settings.guardHooksHint: Events: pre_tool_use (may deny: exit 2 or {"decision":"deny"}), post_tool_use, post_tool_use_failure, run_complete, run_error. command hooks receive the event JSON on stdin; failures fail open.
settings.memoryHint: The AI can remember durable facts across sessions (memory_remember / memory_search tools) and injects relevant memories when planning agent runs. Off by default.
settings.checksumHint: When on, installing a plugin requires its .fyp.sha256 sidecar (from the fengyu CLI packager) and rejects any mismatch — supply-chain hardening for third-party packages.

excelEmail.title: Excel split → batch email
excelEmail.description: Split a workbook by a column (one file per value) and send each file to the matching contact
excelEmail.goal: Split the Excel workbook by the configured column, then batch-send the per-recipient files by email
excelEmail.splitStep: Configure the complex split: analyze the workbook and split one sheet by a column
excelEmail.writeStep: Run the split and write one Excel file per column value
excelEmail.prepareStep: Match each output file to its recipient by filename tag and prepare the batch
excelEmail.sendStep: Confirm and send the prepared batch
excelEmail.workbookHint: The .xlsx file to split. Sheets and columns are read automatically after upload.
excelEmail.rulesHint: One rule per worksheet: split it by the named column — every distinct value becomes its own output file named <workbook>_<value>.xlsx. The value must match the contact's personal tag in the email plugin.
excelEmail.outputDirHint: Files are written to a shared folder the email step reads from — nothing to configure.
excelEmail.recipientTagsHint: Contacts in the selected tags receive the files. Each contact also needs a personal tag equal to its split value.
